The D CORE 2U 19-Inch X25DPRM Industrial Server Rack Mount Black Silver Case is engineered for high-performance server and networking installations. Designed to fit standard 19-inch server racks, this 2U industrial rack mount chassis offers a compact yet powerful solution for servers, NAS systems, NVRs, firewalls, and industrial PCs.


Constructed from high-quality heavy-duty steel, the X25DPRM ensures durability and stability in continuous-operation environments such as data centers, telecom rooms, and enterprise networks. Its black and silver industrial finish provides a professional appearance suitable for modern IT infrastructure.


The case supports multiple storage drives, standard ATX power supplies, and efficient cooling options to maintain optimal system temperatures. Front panel USB ports, power and reset buttons, and LED indicators allow easy monitoring and control. This makes the D CORE 2U rack mount server case an ideal choice for businesses seeking reliability, scalability, and space-efficient rack solutions in Bangladesh.


Key Features

  • 2U Rack Mount Design for standard 19-inch racks
  • Industrial-grade steel construction for long-term durability
  • Black & Silver professional finish
  • Supports industrial servers, NAS, NVR, firewall & networking systems
  • Efficient airflow and cooling support
  • Front USB ports, Power & Reset buttons
  • Ideal for data centers, server rooms & enterprise networks
